channel.title: +अद्वितीय-सङ्कलनम् on गीतेषु वैष्णवेषु विश्वासटिप्पन्यः
channel.description: Recent content in +अद्वितीय-सङ्कलनम् on गीतेषु वैष्णवेषु विश्वासटिप्पन्यः

item.title: ०१ इदियॆनाकु मतमु
item.description:
Idiyenāku Matamu
इदियॆ नाकु मतमु इदि व्रतमु
वुदुटुल कर्ममु वॊल्लनिङ्कनु ॥॥इदि॥
निपुणत हरि ने निनु शरणनुटे
तपमुलु जपमुलु धर्ममुलु
नॆपमुन सकलमु नीवे चेकॊनु
वुपमुल पुण्यमुलॊल्लने यिङ्कनु ॥॥इदि॥
हरि नी दासुड ननुकॊनुटे ना
परमुनु इहमुनु भाग्यमुनु
धर नी मायल तप्पुतॆरुवुलनु
वॊरगी सुकृतमु लॊल्ल ने यिङ्कनु ॥॥इदि॥
नारायण नी नाममु दलचुट
सारपु चदुवुलु शास्त्रमुलु
ईरीति श्री वेङ्कटेश निन्नु गॊलिचिति
वूरक इतरमु लॊल्ल ने यिङ्कनु ॥॥इदि॥
idiye nāku matamu idi vratamu
vuduṭula karmamu vollaniṅkanu ….idi..
nipuṇata hari nē ninu śaraṇanuṭē
tapamulu japamulu dharmamulu
nepamuna sakalamu nīvē cēkonu
vupamula puṇyamulollanē yiṅkanu ….idi..
hari nī dāsuḍa nanukonuṭē nā
paramunu ihamunu bhāgyamunu
dhara nī māyala tapputeruvulanu
voragī sukṛtamu lolla nē yiṅkanu ….idi..
nārāyaṇa nī nāmamu dalacuṭa
sārapu caduvulu śāstramulu
īrīti śrī vēṅkaṭēśa ninnu goliciti
vūraka itaramu lolla nē yiṅkanu ….idi..
This itself is the philosophy for me, this is the vow
Hastily performed actions, I will not resort to.
O Hari, to surrender unto You is in itself a skill,
penance, contemplation and righteousness,
everything done under some pretext that it is for You,
the merits arising out of such means, I will not accept
O Hari, the mere thought that I am Your Dasa
is my wealth for ‘here’ and ‘hereafter’
On earth, though Your maya shows the wrong ways
the fortunes obtained out of it, I will not accept
O Narayana! The thought of Your name alone
is the essence of all learning and scriptural knowledge
In this manner, SreeVenkatesha, I worshipped You
Anything other than this, I will not accept!
458459

item.title: ०२ तॆलिसिनवारिकि तॆरुविदि
item.description:
Telisinavāriki Teruvidi
तॆलिसिनवारिकि तॆरुविदि मरि लेदु
नलिनाक्षु बॊगडॆडि नाममुलो नुन्नदि!॥ तॆलिसि ॥
आकसान लेदु मोक्ष मटु पाताळमुन ले
दीकड भूलोकमन्दु यॆन्दुलेदु
पै कॊनि आसलॆल्ल पारदोलि वॆदकिते
श्रीकान्तु बॊगडेटि चित्तमुलो नुन्नदि!॥ तॆलिसि ॥
सुरलवद्द लेदु सोदिञ्च वमृतमु
सरिदिक्कुलन्दु लेदु जलधिलो लेदु
शरणागतुल पादजलमुलु चेर्चिकॊने
हरिदासुल बूजिञ्चे अरचेतनुन्नदि!॥ तॆलिसि ॥
राजसान सुखमेदि दासि कर्ममन्दु नेदि
वोजतोड नियतुडै वुण्डेवानिदि
साजानि श्रीवेङ्कटेशु सरिमुद्रलु धरिञ्चे
तेजमुतो विज्ञानदेहमुलो वुन्नदि!॥ तॆलिसि ॥
telisinavāriki teruvidi mari lēdu
nalinākṣu bogaḍeḍi nāmamulō nunnadi!.. telisi ..
ākasāna lēdu mōkṣa maṭu pātāḷamuna lē
dīkaḍa bhūlōkamandu yendulēdu
pai koni āsalella pāradōli vedakitē
śrīkāntu bogaḍēṭi cittamulō nunnadi!.. telisi ..
suralavadda lēdu sōdiñca vamṛtamu
saridikkulandu lēdu jaladhilō lēdu
śaraṇāgatula pādajalamulu cērcikonē
haridāsula būjiñcē aracētanunnadi!.. telisi ..
rājasāna sukhamēdi dāsi karmamandu nēdi
vōjatōḍa niyatuḍai vuṇḍēvānidi
sājāni śrīvēṅkaṭēśu sarimudralu dhariñcē
tējamutō vijñānadēhamulō vunnadi!.. telisi ..
For those who know, this is the way, there is none other!
It is in praising the name of the Lotus eyed one!
It is not in the sky, Moksha is not even in the nether world,
not even here, anywhere on earth!
Driving away all the overpowering desires, if sought
it exists in the heart that praises the Lord of Sree!
It is not with the Gods, even if you search, this Amrutha,
not even in any direction, not even in the ocean!
In the palms that accept holy water from the feet of Sharanagatas
and in the palms that worship Hari-dasas, it exists!
Where is the pleasure in kingship, where in doing menial works for others
In those wo are diligent it exists!
Those who whole heartedly wear SreeVenkateshwaras true Mudras
in such enlightened bodies, brilliantly it exists!
460461

item.title: ०३ ऎक्कडि मानुष जन्मम्बॆत्ति
item.description:
Ekkaḍi Mānuṣa Janmambetti
ऎक्कडि मानुष जन्मम्बॆत्तिन फलमेमुन्नदि
निक्कमु निन्ने नम्मिति नी चित्तम्बिकनु ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
मरुवनु आहरम्बुनु मरुवनु संसार सुखमु
मरुवनु इन्द्रियभोगमु माधव नीमाय
मरचॆद सुज्ञानम्बुनु मरचॆद तत्त्व रहस्यमु
मरचॆद गुरुवुनु दैवमु माधव नीमाय ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
विडुवनु पापमु पुण्यमु विडुवनु नादुर्गुणमुलु
विडुवनु मिक्किलि यासलु विष्णुड नीमाय
विडिचॆद षट्कर्मम्बुल विडिचॆद वैराग्यम्बुनु
विडिचॆद नाचारम्बुनु विष्णुड नीमाय ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
तगिलॆद बहुलम्पटमुल तगिलॆद बहुबन्धम्बुल
तगुलनु मोक्षपु मार्गपु तलपुन यॆन्तैना
अगपडि श्री वेङ्कटेश्वर अन्तर्यामिवै
नगिनगि ननु नीवेलिति नाका यी माय ॥॥ ऎक्कडि ॥
ekkaḍi mānuṣa janmambettina phalamēmunnadi
nikkamu ninnē nammiti nī cittambikanu ….ekkaḍi ..
maruvanu āharambunu maruvanu saṃsāra sukhamu
maruvanu iṃdriyabhōgamu mādhava nīmāya
maraceda sujñānambunu maraceda tattva rahasyamu
maraceda guruvunu daivamu mādhava nīmāya ….ekkaḍi ..
viḍuvanu pāpamu puṇyamu viḍuvanu nādurguṇamulu
viḍuvanu mikkili yāsalu viṣṇuḍa nīmāya
viḍiceda ṣaṭkarmambula viḍiceda vairāgyambunu
viḍiceda nācārambunu viṣṇuḍa nīmāya ….ekkaḍi ..
tagileda bahulampaṭamula tagileda bahubandhambula
tagulanu mōkṣapu mārgapu talapuna yentainā
agapaḍi śrī vēṅkaṭēśvara aṃtaryāmivai
naginagi nanu nīvēliti nākā yī māya ….ekkaḍi ..
What is the use of being born as a human?
unless I believe in You always, in my mind!
I don’t forget about food, nor about the comforts of Samsara
I don’t forget the pleasures of the senses, O Madhava! It is your maya!
I forget the right knowledge, and the secrets of the Supreme truths
I forget my Guru, I forget the Lord, O Madhava! It is your maya!
I don’t let go of sins and merits, neither my bad ways
I don’t let go of the many desires, O Vishnu! It is your maya!
I let go of the six main karmas, and even the dispassion
I let go of my customs, O Vishnu! It is your maya!
I come into contact with pleasures and attachments
Never with the path to Moksha, not even in my thoughts!
After You have manifested, O SreeVenkateshwara, as my inner self
and gloriously ruled over me, why still for me this maya??
462463

item.title: ०४ ऒकपरिकॊकपरि
item.description:
Okaparikokapari
ऒकपरि कॊकपरि कॊय्यारमै
मॊकमुन कळलॆल्ल मॊलचिनट्लुण्डॆ ॥॥ ऒक ॥
जगदेकपतिमेन चल्लिन कर्पूरधूळि
जिगिकॊनि नलुवङ्क चिन्दगानु
मॊगि चन्द्रमुखि नुरमुन निलिपॆगान
पॊगरु वॆन्नॆल दिगबोसिनट्लुण्डॆ ॥॥ ऒक ॥
पॊरिमॆरगु चॆक्कुल पूसिन तट्टुपुनुगु
करगि इरुदॆसल कारगानु
करिगमन विभुडु गनुक मोहमदमु
तॊरिगि सामजसिरि तॊलिकिनट्लुण्डॆ ॥॥ ऒक ॥
मॆरय श्रीवेङ्कटेशुमेन सिङ्गारमुगानु
तरचैन सॊम्मुलु धरियिञ्चगा
मॆरगु बोडि अलमेलु मङ्गय तानु
मॆरुपु मेघमु गूडि मॆरसिनट्लुण्डॆ ॥॥ ऒक ॥
okapari kokapari koyyāramai
mokamuna kaḷalella molacinaṭluṇḍe …. oka ..
jagadēkapatimēna callina karpūradhūḷi
jigikoni naluvaṅka cindagānu
mogi candramukhi nuramuna nilipegāna
pogaru vennela digabōsinaṭluṇḍe …. oka ..
porimeragu cekkula pūsina taṭṭupunugu
karagi irudesala kāragānu
karigamana vibhuḍu ganuka mōhamadamu
torigi sāmajasiri tolikinaṭluṇḍe …. oka ..
meraya śrīvēṅkaṭēśumēna siṅgāramugānu
taracaina sommulu dhariyiñcagā
meragu bōḍi alamēlu maṅgayu tānu
merupu mēghamu gūḍi merasinaṭluṇḍe …. oka ..
Each and every time, it is more beautiful than the previous time!
It is as though all forms of art are sprouting from this countenance of the Lord!
Taking along the brilliance of the One Lord of the Universe,
the fine camphor powder spreads around!
Since He has the moon faced consort on His breast,
it seems as though there is thick moonlight radiating all around!
The perfumed oil applied to His cheeks,
is running down along both sides!
Since He is the Lord of the one with the gait of an elephant (Lakshmi)
it seems as though an elephant is secreting his flow of passion!
The shine of Lord Venkateshwaras brilliant body,
bedecked with sparkling ornaments
and adorned by an equally radiant beauty of Alamelumanga
seems as though the cloud and the lightning are shining together!
464465

item.title: ०५ हरि यवतारमॆ आतं डितडु
item.description:
Hari Yavatārame Ātaṃ Ḍitaḍu
हरि यवतारमॆ आतं डितडु
परमु सङ्कीर्तन फलमुलो निलिपॆ ॥॥ हरि ॥
उन्नाडु वैकुण्ठमुन उन्नाडु आचार्युनॊद्द
उन्नतोन्नत महिम अन्नमय्य
उन्नवि सङ्कीर्तनलु ऒट्टुक लोकमुलन्दु
पन्निन नारदादुलु पैपैपाडगानु ॥॥ हरि ॥
चरियिञ्चु नॊकवेळ सनकादिमुनुललो
हरिबाडु ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य
तिरमै याळुवारल तेजमु तानै यण्डु
गरुडानन्त मुख्य घनुल सङ्गडिनि ॥॥ हरि ॥
श्री वेङ्कटाद्रिमीद श्रीपतिकॊलुवुनन्दु
आवहिञ्चे ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य
देवतलु मुनुलुनु देवुण्डनि जयवॆट्ट
कोविदुडै तिरुगाडी कोनेटि दण्डनु ॥॥ हरि ॥
hari yavatārame ātaṃ ḍitaḍu
paramu saṅkīrtana phalamulō nilipe …. hari ..
unnāḍu vaikuṇṭhamuna unnāḍu ācāryunodda
unnatōnnata mahima annamayya
unnavi saṅkīrtanalu oṭṭuka lōkamulandu
pannina nāradādulu paipaipāḍagānu …. hari ..
cariyiñcu nokavēḷa sanakādimunulalō
haribāḍu tāḷḷapāka annamayya
tiramai yāḷuvārala tējamu tānai yuṇḍu
garuḍānanta mukhya ghanula saṅgaḍini …. hari ..
śrī vēṅkaṭādrimīda śrīpatikoluvunandu
āvahiñcē tāḷḷapāka annamayya
dēvatalu munulunu dēvuṇḍani jayaveṭṭa
kōviduḍai tirugāḍī kōnēṭi daṇḍanu …. hari ..
Hari’s avathara he is, ‘He’ only he is
He made the supreme to be the fruits of his Sankirtanas!
He is there in Vaikunta, he is there along with Acharya,
the highest of highest glories is Annamayya!
The are there, the Sankirtanas, in all worlds,
which Narada and others sing everywhere!
At one time he moves about with Sanaka and other sages,
singing about Hari, Tallapaka Annamayya!
Eternally, he himself remains as the brilliance of the Alwars,
in the company of greats like Garuda and Anantha!
On Sree Venkatadri, in the court of Sree-Pathi
he joyously pervaded, Tallapaka Annamayya!
As demigods and sages constantly praise the Lord,
as a highly learned one he did so, and moved about near the Koneru!!
466467

item.title: ०६ ब्रह्म पूजिञ्चॆ रघुपति
item.description:
Brahma Pūjiñce Raghupati
ब्रह्म पूजिञ्चॆ रघुपति विभीषणुन किच्चॆ
ब्रह्मण्युडी डीरङ्गपति गॊलुवरो ॥॥ ब्रह्म ॥
कावेरीमध्य रङ्गक्षेत्र मल्लदिगो
श्रीविमान मदिगो शेषपर्यङ्क मिदे
देवुं डल्लदे वाडे देवि श्रीलक्ष्मियदे
सेविञ्चरो नाभिं जिगुरिञ्चॆ नजुण्डु ॥॥ ब्रह्म ॥
एडुगोटलु नविगो यॆसगपूदोपुलवे
कूडि दामोदरपुरगोपुर मदे
तोग वेयिगम्बाल दॊड्डमण्टप मदिगो
चूडरो पसिडिमिञ्चुलकम्ब मदिगो ॥॥ ब्रह्म ॥
आळुवारलु वारे यङ्गरङ्गविभव मदे
वालु श्रीवैष्णवपुजाड लविगो
आलील श्रीवेङ्कटेशुण्डै वरमच्ची नी
तालिमुल श्रीरङ्गदैवमुङ्गॊलुवरो ॥॥ ब्रह्म ॥
brahma pūjiñce raghupati vibhīṣaṇuna kicce
brahmaṇyuḍī ḍīraṅgapati goluvarō …. brahma ..
kāvērīmadhya raṅgakṣētra malladigō
śrīvimāna madigō śēṣaparyaṅka midē
dēvuṃ ḍalladē vāḍē dēvi śrīlakṣmiyadē
sēviñcarō nābhiṃ jiguriñce najuṇḍu …. brahma ..
ēḍugōṭalu navigō yesagapūdōpulavē
kūḍi dāmōdarapuragōpura madē
tōga vēyigambāla doḍḍamaṇṭapa madigō
cūḍarō pasiḍimiñculakamba madigō …. brahma ..
āḷuvāralu vārē yaṅgaraṅgavibhava madē
vālu śrīvaiṣṇavapujāḍa lavigō
ālīla śrīvēṅkaṭēśuṇḍai varamaccī nī
tālimula śrīraṅgadaivamuṅgoluvarō …. brahma ..
Lord Brahma worshipped Him, Lord Rama gave Him to Vibheeshana!
The Supreme Brahman is the Lord of Srirangam! Offer worship unto Him!
Behold! The holy city of Srirangam, in the middle of Kaveri
Behold the Sree Vimanam, and the couch of Sesha!
The Lord Himself is there, and Goddess Lakshmi is there
Worship this Lord from whose navel Brahma sprouted!
Behold the seven forts, the beautiful flower gardens,
and the gopuram of Lord Damodara!
Behold the mantapam with a thousand pillars
Behold the golden pillar in all splendor!
Here are the Alwars! Behold the excellent Utsavas!
Behold here all the glorious signs of Sree Vaishnavism!
In this manner, as Sree Venkatesha He blesses us
Worship whole heartedly this Lord of Srirangam!
468469

item.title: ०७ दिनमुद्वादशिनेडु तीर्थदिवसमु
item.description:
Dinamudvādaśinēḍu Tīrthadivasamu
दिनमुद्वादशिनेडु तीर्थदिवसमु नीकु
जनकुण्ड अन्नमाचार्युण्ड विच्चेयवे ॥॥दिनमु॥
अनन्त गरुड मुख्यलैन सूरि जनुलतो
घन नारदादि भागवतुलतो
दनुज मर्दनुण्डैन दैवशिखामणितोड
वॆनुकॊनि यारगिञ्च विच्चेयवे ॥॥दिनमु॥
वैकुण्ठान नुण्डि आळुवारल लोपलनुण्डि
लोकपु नित्यमुक्तुल लोन नुण्डि
श्रीकान्त तोड नुन्न श्रीवेङ्कटेशुगूडि
ई कड नारगिञ्च निण्टिकि विच्चेयवे ॥॥दिनमु॥
सङ्कीर्तनमु तोड सनकादुलॆल्ल पाड
पॊङ्कपु श्रीवॆङ्कटाद्रि भूमिनुण्डि
लङ्कॆ श्री वेङ्कटगिरि लक्ष्मी विभुडु नीवु
अङ्कॆल मायिण्टि विन्दुलारगिञ्चवे ॥॥दिनमु॥
dinamudvādaśinēḍu tīrthadivasamu nīku
janakuṇḍa annamācāryuṇḍa viccēyavē ….dinamu..
ananta garuḍa mukhyalaina sūri janulatō
ghana nāradādi bhāgavatulatō
danuja mardanuṇḍaina daivaśikhāmaṇitōḍa
venukoni yāragiñca viccēyavē ….dinamu..
vaikuṇṭhāna nuṇḍi āḷuvārala lōpalanuṇḍi
lōkapu nityamuktula lōna nuṇḍi
śrīkānta tōḍa nunna śrīvēṅkaṭēśugūḍi
ī kaḍa nāragiñca niṇṭiki viccēyavē ….dinamu..
saṅkīrtanamu tōḍa sanakādulella pāḍa
poṅkapu śrīveṅkaṭādri bhūminuṇḍi
laṅke śrī vēṅkaṭagiri lakṣmī vibhuḍu nīvu
aṃkela māyiṇṭi vindulāragiñcavē ….dinamu..
The day is Dwadasi, the day of your demise,
I beseech you to come, O Annamacharya, my dear father.
Bringing along Anantha, Garuda, and the Nitya suris,
the great Narada and other such devotees,
and also with the destroyer of demons, the Lord of Lords,
come to partake the offerings !
From Vaikunta and from the hearts of the Alwars,
from the inside of the Nityas and Muktas who transcended the mortal world,
bringing along SreeVenkatesha with SreeMahalakshmi,
come over to our house, to partake the offerings !
With Sanaka and others singing sankirtanas,
from the divine land of Sree Venkatadri,
together, with the Lord of Lakshmi, the Lord of Venkatagiri,
I beseech you to come as one group, to our home, to partake the offerings!
470471

item.title: ०८ नी गुरुतुलु चूचुको नी बिदुदु
item.description:
Nī Gurutulu Cūcukō Nī Bidudu
नी गुरुतुलु चूचुको नी बिदुदु लॆञ्चुको
यीगतिनि कलबण्टु निक नन्नु गाववे ॥॥नी गुरु॥
कानीले नेनॆन्त कठिनचित्तुडनैन
ना नॊसल निवे पट्टॆ नाममुलु
मेनु तोलु नॆम्मुलतो मॆरसिनदैनानु
पूनिति दम्मितुलसि पूसलपेरुलु॥॥नी गुरु॥
भ्रमसि ने जेसिनदि पापकर्ममुलैनानु
जमळिभुजाल निवे शङ्खचक्रालु
अमरदऱचुगा नेनाडेवि कल्ललैना
तमि बाडीनालिक नीतगु सङ्कीर्तनलु॥॥नी गुरु॥
तलचिते नावोज तामसगुणमैनानु
पिलिचेदि भुविलो नापेरु तिम्मडु
अलर श्री वेङ्कटेश अन्निटने दुष्टुनैना
तलकॊनॆ नायन्दु दासरितनमुलु॥॥नी गुरु॥
nī gurutulu cūcukō nī bidudu leñcukō
yīgatini kalabaṇṭu nika nannu gāvavē ….nī guru..
kānīlē nēnenta kaṭhinacittuḍanaina
nā nosala nivē paṭṭe nāmamulu
mēnu tōlu nemmulatō merasinadainānu
pūniti dammitulasi pūsalapērulu….nī guru..
bhramasi nē jēsinadi pāpakarmamulainānu
jamaḷibhujāla nivē śaṅkhacakrālu
amaradaṟacugā nēnāḍēvi kallalainā
tami bāḍīnālika nītagu saṅkīrtanalu….nī guru..
talacitē nāvōja tāmasaguṇamainānu
pilicēdi bhuvilō nāpēru timmaḍu
alara śrī vēṅkaṭēśa anniṭanē duṣṭunainā
talakone nāyandu dāsaritanamulu….nī guru..
Behold these signs of Yours on me! Consider these marks of Yours!
As I am your servant with all these, do protect me,
Even if I am a very heard hearted one
on my forehead there is the naamam!
Though my body is made up of skin and bones
I wear the subjugating strings of Tulasi beads!
Even if I commit sinful deeds under illusion
upon my shoulders are the marks of the Shanka-Chakra!
Though I frequently may utter lies,
with eagerness, my tongue sings Your Sankirtanas!
To say rightly, my nature is that of Tamas
Yet, upon this earth I am known as ‘Timmadu’1
O Venkatesha! Even if I am evil in many ways
there exist in me many qualities of a true Vaishnava servant!
1.Pedda Tirumalacharyas name is the appellation of God
472473
II Srimathe Ramanujaya Namaha II
Sree Chinna Tirumalacharya
Sankirtanas
474475

item.title: ०९ अप्पनि वरप्रसादि
item.description:
Appani Varaprasādi
अप्पनि वरप्रसादि अन्नमय्य
अप्पसमु माके कलडन्नमय्य ॥॥अप्पनि॥
अन्तटिकि एलिकैन आदिनारायणु तन
अन्तरङ्गान निलिपिन अन्नमय्य
सन्तसान चॆलुवुन्दे सनकसनन्दनादु -
लन्तटिवाडु ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य ॥॥अप्पनि॥
बिरुदु टॆक्कॆमुलुगा पॆक्कु सङ्कीर्तनमुलु
हरिमीद विन्नविञ्चॆ नन्नमय्य
विरिविगलिगिनट्टि वेदमुल अर्थमॆल्ल
अरसि तॆलिपिनवाडु अन्नमय्य ॥॥अप्पनि॥
अन्दमैन रामानुजाचार्यमतमुनु
अन्दुकॊनि निलिचिनाडु अन्नमय्य
विन्दुवलॆ माकुनु श्री वेङ्कटनाथुनिनिच्चॆ
अन्दरिलो ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य ॥॥अप्पनि॥
appani varaprasādi annamayya
appasamu mākē kalaḍannamayya ….appani..
aṃtaṭiki ēlikaina ādinārāyaṇu tana
aṃtaraṅgāna nilipina annamayya
santasāna celuvundē sanakasanandanādu -
lantaṭivāḍu tāḷḷapāka annamayya ….appani..
birudu ṭekkemulugā pekku saṅkīrtanamulu
harimīda vinnaviñce nannamayya
virivigaliginaṭṭi vēdamula arthamella
arasi telipinavāḍu annamayya ….appani..
aṃdamaina rāmānujācāryamatamunu
aṃdukoni nilicināḍu annamayya
vinduvale mākunu śrī vēṅkaṭanāthuninicce
aṃdarilō tāḷḷapāka annamayya ….appani..
Almighty’s gifted boon is Annamayya,
Forever he is ours, Annamayya!
The presiding deity of the entire Universe, the primeval Narayana,
he had placed within his heart, Annamayya!
Reveling in supreme beatitude, as the likes of Sanaka, Sanandana,
also is Tallapaka Annamayya!
Ensigning His many qualities, he composed various Sankirtanas,
on Lord Sree Hari, Annamayya!
Having mastered the profound knowledge of the Vedas
he taught the essence , Annamayya!
The glorious philosophy of Ramanujacharya,
he got initiated into and stood for it, Annamayya!
Like a feast, he openly offered to us Sree Venkatanatha,
that Tallapaka Annamayya!
476477

item.title: १० सङ्कॆलेक तलचिन जाणलकु
item.description:
Saṅkelēka Talacina Jāṇalaku
सङ्कॆलेक तलचिन जाणलकु
सङ्कीर्तनमॆ पो सर्वशान्ति!॥ सङ्कॆ ॥
भवहरमगु श्रीपति नाममॆ
जवकट्टि तलचिते जन्मशान्ति
तविलि हरिपूज ताजेयटे
कुवलयमुन निदिगो गृहशान्ति!॥ सङ्कॆ ॥
अन्दि धृववरदुड यनिनदॆ
कन्दुवैन सर्वग्रहशान्ति
यिन्दु रविनयनुनि नॆरुगुटॆ
चन्दमैनदिदिवो नक्षत्रशान्ति!॥ सङ्कॆ ॥
भाविञ्चि यनन्तुनि बलुकुटॆ
काविञ्चिन दिदिवो कालशान्ति
श्री वॆङ्कटनाधुनि चेरुटे
देव मानवुलकुनु देहशान्ति!॥ सङ्कॆ ॥
saṅkelēka talacina jāṇalaku
saṅkīrtaname pō sarvaśānti!.. saṅke ..
bhavaharamagu śrīpati nāmame
javakaṭṭi talacitē janmaśānti
tavili haripūja tājēyuṭē
kuvalayamuna nidigō gṛhaśānti!.. saṅke ..
aṃdi dhṛvavaraduḍa yaninade
kanduvaina sarvagrahaśānti
yindu ravinayanuni neruguṭe
candamainadidivō nakṣatraśānti!.. saṅke ..
bhāviñci yanantuni balukuṭe
kāviñcina didivō kālaśānti
śrī veṅkaṭanādhuni cēruṭē
dēva mānavulakunu dēhaśānti!.. saṅke ..
For wise people who believe without doubts,
Sankirtana itself is the ‘Sarva-shanti’
The destroyer of the miseries of Samsara, the name of Sree-Pathi
eagerly contemplating on it bestows ‘Janma-shanti’
Unfailingly if one performs the worship of Hari
in this world, that itself bestows ‘Griha-shanti’
If one realizes and chants the name of the Lord who blessed Dhruva,
that alone is the appropriate ‘Graha-shanti’
Knowing the one who has the sun and moon as eyes
that itself bestows the beautiful ‘Nakshatra-shanti’
With thoughts fixed on Anantha, saying His name
that itself bestows ‘Kaala-shanti’
Reaching unto SreeVenkatanatha is itself,
for Gods and humans, the ‘Deha-shanti’!
478479

item.title: ११ हरियवतार मीतडु अन्नमय्य
item.description:
Hariyavatāra Mītaḍu Annamayya
हरियवतार मीतडु अन्नमय्य
अरय मा गुरुडीतडु अन्नमय्य ॥॥ हरि ॥
वैकुण्ठनाथुनि वद्द वडिपाडुचुन्नवाडु
आकरमै ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य
आकसपु विष्णुपादमन्दु नित्यमै उन्नवाडु
आकडीकड ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य ॥॥ हरि ॥
क्षीराब्धिशायि निट्टे सेविम्पुचु नुन्नवाडु
आरितेरि ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य
धीरुडै सूर्यमण्डल तेजमुवद्द नुन्नवाडु
आ रीतुल ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य ॥॥ हरि ॥
ईवल संसारलील इन्दिरेशुतो नुन्नवाडु
आवटिञ्चि ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य
भाविम्प श्री वेण्टेशु पादमुलन्दु उन्नवाडु
हावभावमै ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमय्य ॥॥ हरि ॥
hariyavatāra mītaḍu annamayya
araya mā guruḍītaḍu annamayya …. hari ..
vaikuṇṭhanāthuni vadda vaḍipāḍucunnavāḍu
ākaramai tāḷḷapāka annamayya
ākasapu viṣṇupādamandu nityamai unnavāḍu
ākaḍīkaḍa tāḷḷapāka annamayya …. hari ..
kṣīrābdhiśāyi niṭṭē sēvimpucu nunnavāḍu
āritēri tāḷḷapāka annamayya
dhīruḍai sūryamaṇḍala tējamuvadda nunnavāḍu
ā rītula tāḷḷapāka annamayya …. hari ..
īvala saṃsāralīla iṃdirēśutō nunnavāḍu
āvaṭiñci tāḷḷapāka annamayya
bhāvimpa śrī vēṇṭēśu pādamulandu unnavāḍu
hāvabhāvamai tāḷḷapāka annamayya …. hari ..
Hari’s avatara he is, Annamayya!
When understood rightly, our preceptor, Annamayya!
In the presence of the Lord of Vaikunta, he sings with celerity
the abundantly endowed Tallapaka Annamayya!
In the Heavens, eternally residing at the feet of Vishnu,
everywhere he is present, Tallapaka Annamayya!
In serving the Lord who reclines on the milky ocean,
he excels, Tallapaka Annamayya!
A valiant one close to the brilliance of the orb of the sun
In this manner he exists, Tallapaka Annamayya!
Though in the grip of samsara, being close to the Lord of Indira
he led his life, Tallapaka Annamayya!
If perceived, he is at the feet of Sree Venkatesha
Exulting with total adoration, Tallapaka Annamayya!!
480481

item.title: १२ ताळ्ळपाकन्नमाचार्य दैवमवु
item.description:
Tāḷḷapākannamācārya Daivamavu
ताळ्ळपाकन्नमाचार्य दैवमवु नीवु माकु
वेळमॆ श्रीहरि गनेवॆर वानतिच्चितिवि ॥॥ ताळ्ळ ॥
गुरुडवु नीवेसुम्मी कुमति नैननाकु
सरवि ब्रह्मोपदेशमु सेसिति
परमबन्धुड वैना परिकिम्प नीवे सुम्मी
वरुस ने जॆडकुण्ड वहिञ्चुकॊण्टिवि ॥॥ ताळ्ळ ॥
तल्लिवैन नीवेसुम्मी तगिन विषयाललो
पल्लदान बडकुण्डा ब्रदिकिञ्चिति
अल्लुकॊनि तोडुनीडवैना नीवे सुम्मी
चिल्लरमायललोन जॆडकुण्डा जेसिति ॥॥ ताळ्ळ ॥
दातवु नीवे सुम्मी तगु श्रीवॆङ्कटनाथु
नातलपुलो निलिपि नम्म जेसिति
येतल जाचिना नाकु नेडुगडय नीवॆ
आतल नातल नन्नु नादुकॊनि काचिति ॥॥ ताळ्ळ ॥
tāḷḷapākannamācārya daivamavu nīvu māku
vēḷame śrīhari ganēvera vānaticcitivi …. tāḷḷa ..
guruḍavu nīvēsummī kumati nainanāku
saravi brahmōpadēśamu sēsiti
paramabandhuḍa vainā parikimpa nīvē summī
varusa nē jeḍakuṇḍa vahiñcukoṇṭivi …. tāḷḷa ..
tallivaina nīvēsummī tagina viṣayālalō
palladāna baḍakuṇḍā bradikiñciti
allukoni tōḍunīḍavainā nīvē summī
cillaramāyalalōna jeḍakuṇḍā jēsiti …. tāḷḷa ..
dātavu nīvē summī tagu śrīveṅkaṭanāthu
nātalapulō nilipi namma jēsiti
yētala jūcinā nāku nēḍugaḍayu nīve
ātala nātala nannu nādukoni kāciti …. tāḷḷa ..
O Tallapaka Annamacharya! You are the God for us!
You showed us the means to perceive Sree Hari!
You alone are the Guru for me, an ignorant one I am,
you performed my Brahmopadesham,
you alone are my supreme relation if understood rightly,
you took care to ensure that I do not go astray!
In certain matters, you are like a mother
you saved me from falling for undesirable things
you were my constant companion,
preventing me from getting lured by cheap trickery!
You are the bestower! You placed Sree Venkatanatha
in my thoughts and made me believe in Him!
In which ever manner perceived, you are my protector
In every way you rescued me and guarded me!
482483

item.title: १३ ईतडे मुक्तिदोव यीतडे
item.description:
Ītaḍē Muktidōva Yītaḍē
ईतडे मुक्तिदोव यीतडे मा याचार्यु-
डीतडु गलुगबट्टि इन्दरु बदिकिरि ॥॥ईतडे॥
अदिवो ताळ्ळपाक अन्नमाचार्युलु
यिदॆ वीडॆ श्रीवेङ्कटेशु नॆदुट
वॆदवॆट्टि लोकमुलो वेदमुलन्निय मञ्चि-
पदमुलु सेसि पाडि पावनमुसेसॆनु ॥॥ईतडे॥
अलरुचु दाळ्ळपाक अन्नमाचार्युलु
निलिचि श्रीवेङ्कटनिधिये तानै
कलिदोषमुलु वाप घनपुराणमुलॆल्ल
पलुकुल निञ्चि निञ्चि पाडिनाडु हरिनि ॥॥ईतडे॥
अङ्गविञ्चॆ दाळ्ळपाक अन्नमाचार्युलु
बङ्गारु श्रीवॆङ्कटेशु पादमुलन्दु
रङ्गुमीऱ श्रीवेङ्कटरमणुनि यलमेलु-
मङ्गनु यिद्दरि बाडि मम्मु गरुणिञ्चॆनु ॥॥ईतडे॥
ītaḍē muktidōva yītaḍē mā yācāryu-
ḍītaḍu galugabaṭṭi iṃdaru badikiri ….ītaḍē..
adivō tāḷḷapāka annamācāryulu
yide vīḍe śrīvēṅkaṭēśu neduṭa
vedaveṭṭi lōkamulō vēdamulanniyu mañci-
padamulu sēsi pāḍi pāvanamusēsenu ….ītaḍē..
alarucu dāḷḷapāka annamācāryulu
nilici śrīvēṅkaṭanidhiyē tānai
kalidōṣamulu vāpa ghanapurāṇamulella
palukula niñci niñci pāḍināḍu harini ….ītaḍē..
aṃgaviñce dāḷḷapāka annamācāryulu
baṅgāru śrīveṅkaṭēśu pādamulandu
raṅgumīṟa śrīvēṅkaṭaramaṇuni yalamēlu-
maṅganu yiddari bāḍi mammu garuṇiñcenu ….ītaḍē..
He alone is the way to salvation! He alone is our Acharya!
Because of him, everyone survived!
Behold! Tallapaka Annamacharya he is!
He is right in front of Sree Venkatesha!
Spreading the Vedas in all the worlds, he composed them into songs
and having sung them, he bestowed purity!
Joyously, Tallapaka Annamacharya stood as
the very embodiment of the treasure of Sree Venkatesha!
To absolve the sins of Kali-Yuga, all the great Puranas,
he filled into the words of his songs, and sung about Hari!
He, Tallapaka Annamacharya, merged into
the golden feet of Sree Venkatesha!
In a beautiful manner, he sang on both Lord Sree Venkatesha
and Alamelumanga, and graced all of us!
484485

item.title: १४ ऎट्टिहितोपदेशकु डॆटुवण्टि
item.description:
Eṭṭihitōpadēśaku Ḍeṭuvaṇṭi
ऎट्टिहितोपदेशकु डॆटुवण्टि दयाळुवु
अट्टॆ ताळ्ळपाकन्नमाचार्युडु ॥॥ऎट्टि॥
पच्चितामसुल मम्मु बरमसात्विकुलगा
यिच्चटनॆ सेसिनाडु यॆन्तचित्तमु
इच्चगिञ्चि माकुलान नॆन्नडु लेनि वैष्णव-
मच्चमुगा गृपसेसॆ नन्नमाचार्युडु ॥॥ऎट्टि॥
मुदिरिन पापकर्ममुलु सेसिनट्टि मम्मु
यॆदुट बुण्युल जेसॆ नॆन्त सोद्यमु
कदिसि ये जन्मान गाननिसङ्कीर्तन-
मदन नुपदेशिञ्चॆ नन्नमाचार्युडु ॥॥ऎट्टि॥
गडुसुदनपु मम्मु गडुविवेकुल जेसि
यिडुमलॆल्ला बापॆ नेमरुडु (गुरुडु?)
नडुमने यन्नडु गाननि श्रीवेङ्कटनाथु-
नडियालमुग निच्चॆ नन्नमाचार्युडु ॥॥ऎट्टि॥
eṭṭihitōpadēśaku ḍeṭuvaṇṭi dayāḷuvu
aṭṭe tāḷḷapākannamācāryuḍu ….eṭṭi..
paccitāmasula mammu baramasātvikulagā
yiccaṭane sēsināḍu yentacittamu
iccagiñci mākulāna nennaḍu lēni vaiṣṇava-
maccamugā gṛpasēse nannamācāryuḍu ….eṭṭi..
mudirina pāpakarmamulu sēsinaṭṭi mammu
yeduṭa buṇyula jēse nenta sōdyamu
kadisi yē janmāna gānanisaṅkīrtana-
madana nupadēśiñce nannamācāryuḍu ….eṭṭi..

A great well wishing adviser! A highly compassionate one!
Such is Tallapaka Annamcharya!
Highly tamasik ones like us, into supremely sattvik ones
right here he transformed! What a wonder!
Annamcharya, by his free will, graced us and became the
mark of Vaishnavism, which our clan never had before!
We who had committed many a heinous sins,
he transformed into meritorious ones! What a wonder!
That Sankirtana which we never could see in our previous births
he initiated to us, our Annamacharya!
We who were full of vanity, into very wise ones he transformed
and thus averted our hardships, Our Guru!
That Sree Venkatesha whom we could never perceive earlier
like a divine token he bestowed on us, our Annamacharya!
